source_snapshot.procedure: Check Overview and `View more` inventory, then turn an LED on and off and check physical behavior.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information matches SPEC and LED behavior is correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES substitutes a likely nonstandard read-only inventory GET, omits the LED state change and physical observation, assumes ChassisId and calls it no-risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION restores target mapping, bounded LED change, physical observer, readback, fault/ownership controls and restoration.

old_problem: The historical record preserved both inventory and physical LED coverage but retained Pending for the exact inventory matrix, controllable locator target, visual behavior, owner/fault context and recovery.
disposition_reason: The two source checkpoints are explicit. Project component fields, exact locator/identify LED resource and expected visual pattern are supplyable inputs, while ED-09 assigns physical LED observation to a human. The Review layer distinguishes locator/identify from fault/status indicators, uses three-layer command/logical/physical evidence, and restores the exact baseline rather than blindly forcing Off. ED-20 preserves both inventory and on/off branches, ED-35 rejects read-only substitution, and ED-38 requires explicit state-change approval and no retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 858, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
Physical LED function requires correlation of requested state, BMC readback and emitted color/blink/location; API readback alone is insufficient.
Locator/identify controls must not be confused with fault/health indicators whose state represents a real condition.
Inventory correctness remains an independent exhaustive component/instance/SPEC comparison across Overview and View more.

test_case.test_name: Verify complete inventory and one approved physical locator/identify LED on/off sequence
test_case.purpose: Prove every Project-required Inventory field in Overview and `View more` matches the signed component/instance/location SPEC, then prove the exact approved controllable locator/identify LED responds logically and physically to one bounded active/inactive sequence with correct color/blink/location and exact baseline restoration, without affecting another indicator or service state.
required_package: Exact BMC/controller/certificate, firmware/WebUI build, chassis and inventory topology
Signed inventory field/value/source matrix for every required Overview and View-more component instance
Exact LED purpose, component/chassis resource or UI control, physical location label and proof it is locator/identify rather than fault/status unless explicitly designed otherwise
Vendor-supported write/readback semantics, preferring LocationIndicatorActive when supported or documenting legacy IndicatorLED/OEM equivalence
Baseline logical/physical state, active locator owner, fault/status context, expected active/inactive color/blink/timing and maximum dwell
Qualified physical observer/camera, protected authentication, explicit approval, cleanup proof and wrong/stuck-LED recovery
test_case.test_command: First discover and bind the BMC/chassis/component inventory and LED identities. Capture Overview and `View more` once and reconcile every matrix field with signed SPEC and authoritative read-only resources. Before any LED change, record exact logical/physical baseline, current locator owner and all fault/status context; confirm the target resource maps to the labeled physical locator and the qualified observer is ready. After explicit approval, set the supported locator/identify control active once for the bounded dwell, record command/readback and synchronized physical color/blink/location, set it inactive once and observe/read back again, then restore the recorded baseline if it was not inactive. Verify no unrelated LED, inventory, power or fault state changed. Do not clear logs, use an invented `/Inventory` URI, toggle an unspecified/fault LED or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every required inventory field and component instance matches the signed SPEC in both UI views. The approved locator/identify resource controls exactly the intended physical LED: active and inactive logical readback and physical color/blink/location match the approved behavior within timing limits. The exact pre-test baseline and ownership context are restored, no fault is masked, no unrelated indicator or service state changes and audit evidence is preserved.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete inventory-matrix evidence plus exact LED target/purpose/location binding, explicit approval, one active/inactive sequence, synchronized command/logical/physical evidence for both states, exact baseline restoration and engineer/operator verdicts. Inventory JSON, UI/API state, photo alone or forcing Off without knowing baseline cannot pass. Wrong/stuck/no physical LED, readback disagreement, masked fault, owner conflict, unexpected related state change, inventory mismatch or failed restoration is FAIL. Missing target/behavior/observer/recovery is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Do not reduce the case to inventory or logical readback; the original physical on/off checkpoint requires a qualified observer.
Do not toggle until resource/control and physical label prove the exact locator/identify LED and exclude an active health/fault indicator.
Capture baseline and current owner and restore that exact state; never assume final Off is correct.
Use one approved active/inactive sequence with bounded dwell and stop on wrong lamp, fault masking, owner conflict, state disagreement or failed restore; no automatic retry.
Discover actual chassis/component/assembly resources for inventory; do not assume `/Chassis/system/Inventory`.
Use trusted TLS/protected secrets, preserve BMC/SEL/host/fault logs and redact asset/location images under policy.
expected_evidence: BMC/chassis/component identity, certificate, firmware/WebUI build and mapped inventory/LED resource schemas
Signed inventory field/component/instance/location/value matrix and redacted Overview/View-more comparison
Physical LED purpose/location/photo reference, baseline logical/physical state, current owner and no-conflicting-fault evidence
Approved active/inactive requests with timestamps, UI/API readback and synchronized physical observation of color/blink/location for both states
Proof exact baseline restoration, no unrelated LED/inventory/power/fault change and healthy BMC/host
Preserved audit/fault logs, explicit coverage limits and authorized engineer/operator verdicts
test_case.recovery: If the wrong LED changes, a fault is obscured or restoration fails, stop without another toggle, preserve command/readback/physical/audit evidence and use only the approved mapped control plus qualified onsite/OOB owner to restore the recorded baseline. Escalate a stuck indicator or masked fault; do not guess another resource or force unrelated LEDs.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently combine inventory verification with LED on/off physical behavior; the missing target is a parameter, not a competing purpose.

blocked.reason: Both purposes are identifiable; component/LED mapping, expected behavior, observer and recovery are supplyable execution inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/chassis/UI identity, exhaustive inventory matrix, exact locator/identify resource and physical label, baseline/owner/fault context, visual pattern/dwell, human observer and recovery.
